name: Grunt Logmar
summary: Grunt Logmar is an orc warrior of the Horde stationed in the southern Barrens at Camp Taurajo. Dutiful and vigilant, he monitors threats surrounding the camp and coordinates efforts to locate and aid missing Horde scouts in the region.

sections.title: Duty at Camp Taurajo
sections.body: Stationed among the tauren at Camp Taurajo, Grunt Logmar serves as a watchful orc guard on the southern Barrens frontier. The settlement sits close to hostile quilboar grounds and the mountain passes leading into Stonetalon and Mulgore, requiring constant vigilance. Logmar coordinates scouting reports and reaches out to capable Horde travelers when his comrades find themselves ambushed or captured by local hostiles.

faq.answer: Grunt Logmar is an orc soldier stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, serving the Horde by securing the settlement and overseeing rescue and reconnaissance tasks.

faq.q: Where can Grunt Logmar be found?
faq.answer: He is located in Camp Taurajo, an outpost situated in the southern plains of the Barrens along the road leading toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles.

Logmar deals with the safety of missing Horde scouts, notably tasking travelers to investigate the disappearance and captivity of fellow grunt Dogran and secure vital supplies like Ken'zigla's draught.

angles.text: Logmar represents the frontline military presence supporting the tauren in the Barrens, relying on Horde champions to look after fallen and captured scouts.
As an orc grunt stationed far from Orgrimmar, Logmar demonstrates the Horde's commitment to standing shoulder-to-shoulder with their tauren allies.
